title: Chapter 1291
text:
This was a white space that stretched as far as the eye could see. There was nothing here, and it looked completely empty.

Suddenly, a whirlpool-like blue teleportation gate appeared out of thin air, and Han Xiao, Joey, and the other three flew out.

"This is the prototype of the secondary dimension I created. We usually spar here. Black Star, you don't have any objections, right?"

Joey sent a mental message with a sullen face.

"Sure."

Han Xiao looked around and nodded.

After reaching an agreement to spar, because they were worried about destroying the Four God Nations, they decided to change the battlefield. Joey opened the teleportation gate and led everyone to his usual training ground.

High-grade Mages could use spells like Illusion Materialization to artificially create secondary dimensions. This white world was just an incomplete prototype, and it was very simple to create. It was perfect for a battlefield.

"Although you want to fight one against four, we won't take advantage of you. At most, we'll fight you one by one until one side concedes."

Joey snorted and retreated to open up the distance between them. The others also retreated in different directions.

Han Xiao smiled and did not speak. He opened the interface and took a look.

A notification popped up, indicating that a special mission had been triggered. The format was similar to the Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission, requiring one to last a certain amount of time in battle. The rewards were divided into different levels, and the two highest levels were to choose one random ability from each of the four people and obtain a talent called [Secondary Dimension Adaptor].

The effect of this talent was to obtain an environmental bonus when fighting in the secondary dimension, increasing one's combat strength slightly. It was a general ability, and it was better than nothing.

"Heh, if only there were such surprises every time."

Han Xiao's lips curled up slightly.

At this time, Joey, who had already opened up a large distance, stopped. He formed a few hand seals and pointed in the air. A series of magic arrays appeared behind him, turning into light gates. Countless monsters surged out. There were humanoid shadow creatures, strangely twisted monsters, soft-bodied creatures with a combination of various structures … They were all monsters from different secondary dimensions.

"You want to fight me with the Summoning Stream?"

Han Xiao nodded secretly.

Since the other party had inquired about his name, it was natural that they would not approach him so easily. It seemed that they wanted to use the human wave tactic to restrict him.

Joey was not a specialized summoner, but he had lived in the secondary dimensions for many years and had seen many strange secondary dimension life forms. He had signed a lot of contracts and could summon a lot of targets, most of which were very strong.

Han Xiao immediately knew what the other party was planning to do. He wanted to rely on his solid foundation to fight. The other party probably thought that he had not been a Beyond Grade A for long enough and that his foundation was his weakness.

"Then I'll play with you."

Han Xiao did not take it to heart. He opened the dimensional army box, and an endless Mech Legion flew out. Compared to the messy formation of the summoned monsters, the Mech Legion's formation was extremely orderly. They rapidly formed different formations, and the black mass of Steel Legion emitted a unique sense of beauty.

Then, he summoned the Divine Mechanical Throne and sat on it, floating in the center of the mechanical army like the commander of the army.

The number of the Mech Legion and summoned monsters increased, and the battle line was quickly stretched out. The end could not be seen at a glance, forming a confrontation.

The summoned monsters' formation frequently let out roars that shook one's mind, and it was extremely noisy. On the other hand, the Mech Legion was on the other end of the spectrum, silent as death.

Seeing that the troops on both sides had opened up their formation, Han Xiao waved his hand and ordered.

"Let's do it."

As soon as he said that, the Mech Legion immediately began to move in an orderly manner.

The heavy armored vanguard troops at the front raised their shields and moved forward in an orderly manner. The long-range mechanical troops in the middle and rear immediately unleashed their firepower. The dense psionic beams seemed to have turned into a curtain of light, directly focusing fire on the summoned monsters. Light balls frequently exploded in the enemy formation, causing large numbers of summoned monsters to suffer casualties. In the vertical direction, the elite vanguard troops engaged in three-dimensional combat, independent guerrilla warfare, like sharp knives or sniper rifles, looking for opportunities to attack the weak points of the enemy formation.

At the same time, large patches of golden lightning chains were released from the Divine Mechanical Throne, instantly connecting the mechanical troops, forming a spider web shape, giving the Mech Legion a Mechanical Force boost. A large number of mechanical soldiers were dyed in golden lightning, and their performance increased by a visible margin as though they had entered a state of excitement.

On the other side, Joey was not to be outdone. He waved his staff, and patches of magic light sprinkled on the summoned monsters, also bringing about an area of effect buff. Then, the summoned monster army was like a flash flood, crazily charging toward the Mech Legion's formation!

Although there were many types of summoned creatures, their formation was not scattered. Under the buffs of Joey's spells, the different types of summoned creatures formed a formation, and their abilities complemented each other. There was a tactical cooperation, not a swarm of bees charging out randomly.

The two torrents rapidly approached each other, then collided with a loud bang, like Mars colliding with Earth!

Rumble!

A chaotic battle broke out instantly, and the scene became extremely heated. The troops of both sides clashed, and machinery clashed with flesh. It was difficult to tell who had the upper hand, extremely tragic!

In just one exchange, the Mech Legion showed a crushing momentum, crazily crushing the summoned creature army. The summoned creatures were reduced to dust one after another under the assault of the mechanical army.

"What a strong Mech Legion!"

Joey was startled and hurriedly cast a short-term buff spell to stabilize the frontline troops. He also cast a HP recovery spell to heal their injuries.

Unfortunately, these methods were all in vain.

The current Han Xiao was terrifyingly strong. With his God's Trait Transformation, Machinery Faith, Proof of Leadership, Machinery Divinity, and so on, his Mechanical Force was the strongest in the universe. Even the Mecha Empire could not compare to him.

Furthermore, the decades of research on Jayz's technology treasures had allowed his Mech Legion to be updated and strengthened many times. Not only did he add many new types of powerful combat machines, but his performance had also improved by leaps and bounds. It was an all-around strength.

Han Xiao's current combat strength was almost at the top level in the universe. He did not need to go all out, and he could crush his enemies fair and square without any fancy moves.

Joey's summoned monster army was no match for Han Xiao's Mech Legion at all!

The battlefield quickly became one-sided. The mechanical army advanced and retreated with a tight battle formation. They charged back and forth, constantly tearing apart the formations of the summoned monsters and devouring them.

At the back, Han Xiao sat firmly on his Divine Mechanical Throne, adjusting the target of his Mechanical Force buff at any time. He currently had too many soldiers, and it was difficult for his Mechanical Force to cover all of them. Thus, he had to constantly adjust the focus of the buff as a commander to control the overall situation and take control of the battlefield.

At the same time, Han Xiao also activated a specific battle formation buff. This was a command type skill commonly used in the Army Style. Different battle formations, formations, and tactics had a chance of being in the form of a skill. It was a command type skill that provided an overall bonus to the army. Most of them increased their attack, defense, mobility, and other attributes by less than ten percent.

Very soon, the summoning army suffered heavy casualties. Joey felt a little pained. He raised his hand and drew magic from the Mage Tower. Then, he slapped his palm toward a group of mechanical troops.

Hum!

A huge golden magic formation bloomed like a lotus flower, and a strange spatial collapse occurred in an area of the mechanical army. Spatial turbulence raged out, but it was limited to this circular area.

The mechanical soldiers in this area seemed to have been erased by an eraser, instantly disappearing into thin air. The mechanical soldiers that entered this area would also disappear into thin air.

Han Xiao looked over and narrowed his eyes.

"An instant-cast banishing spell that can continue to exist as a trap. This spell is quite something …"

These mechanical soldiers that disappeared were not destroyed but were banished into the spatial turbulence of the secondary dimension by Joey's spell. They were all scattered and fell to god knows where. The effect was somewhat similar to the Holy Covenant's Dimensional Banishing Bullet, but the effect was even better.

One of the reasons this guy was suitable for fighting in the secondary dimension was because he had many self-created spells that were only effective here. They would not be of any use in the main universe egg.

Joey threw out a few more palms and banished a few more mechanical soldiers. At this time, he suddenly felt a sense of danger. He activated the short-range teleportation enchantment without hesitation and instantly left the place.

Swoosh!

The next moment, a highly condensed blue-black ray shot out, penetrating layers of paper-like magic barriers and hitting the afterimage left behind.

Joey flashed to the side and turned to look in the direction of the beam. He saw that Han Xiao had unknowingly changed into a set of pitch-black armor and was pointing his finger in this direction. The fingertips of the mechanical suit were still flickering.

"You dodged pretty quickly. I thought I would be able to test the actual combat effect of this anti-magic gamma ray."

Han Xiao's tone was a little regretful.

The style of a normal Mechanic would be to prepare countermeasures against any enemy. In the past few years, Han Xiao had created a large number of new weapons targeting the five major systems, completely transforming himself.

This anti-magic gamma ray was based on highly condensed gamma rays that imitated a gamma ray burst. It was supplemented by the magic suppression energy converted by psionic energy, which had astonishing penetrative power and lethality against the Mage class. According to the laboratory's report, after hitting a Beyond Grade A Mage, it would be able to exert a 'magic activity suppression' state for a few hours, greatly weakening the strength of the opponent's spells.

Han Xiao shook his head, stood up from the throne, and suddenly disappeared.

Joey was immediately alarmed. He turned his hand and used a Battle Mage's Magic Shockwave behind him, blocking Han Xiao's fist.

Boom!

The fist and palm collided, and a blue-purple shockwave burst out!

Joey was about to use the force to increase the distance between them when he suddenly realized that his palm was stuck to Han Xiao's fist. The black mechanical suit on Han Xiao's body suddenly lit up with fluorescent blue psionic energy patterns, flickering as though it was breathing.

At this moment, Joey's expression changed drastically. He realized that with the fist and palm as the center, all the energy in his body began to flow uncontrollably into Han Xiao's body as though it was being sucked away.

Psionic Energy Gathering Decay Module, a new technology created by Han Xiao. By simulating the process of the birth and transformation of psionic energy, it displayed the characteristic of devouring all energy. Even when coming into contact with a Super, as long as the judgment requirements were met, it could assimilate and absorb the energy of the other party, turning it into fuel for the energy furnace.

Simply put … this was the Star Sucking Great Technique!

At this moment, Joey made a prompt decision and activated the enchantment. A chaotic space stream appeared out of nowhere and swallowed him. He instantly broke free from the control of the enchantment and disappeared without a trace.

"Yo, you have quite a few escape methods."

Han Xiao raised his brows and looked around. Far away from the battlefield, a chaotic space stream gushed out and spat Joey out. The chaotic space stream that he could not control seemed to have become his vehicle.

"That was close … In just a short contact, I lost about five percent of my energy." Joey did not have time to rest and quickly checked his status. He was shocked.

At this moment, the blue patterns on Han Xiao's mechanical suit dimmed. He shook his head and smiled.

"You guys should come together. There's no pressure at all when dealing with just you alone."

Hearing this, Joey's face darkened. The other three who were watching the battle did not look good either.

After the previous exchange, Joey had personally experienced Han Xiao's strength. He felt that Han Xiao was strong without any shortcomings, like an insurmountable mountain. He could not think of how he could defeat Black Star with his own strength.

Furthermore, he was the strongest among the four. Although the other three had not fought yet, seeing Joey's pathetic performance, they were all shocked. They knew that the result would be the same if they went up against Han Xiao. They might even be beaten up even worse.

If they went up one by one, it would be suicide. They could only take turns to be beaten up!

Realizing this, the other three were tempted by Han Xiao's suggestion.

Originally, they did not want to go up together because they wanted to maintain their dignity as Beyond Grade As. However, it seemed that if they were beaten up one by one, there would be no dignity to speak of. They might as well gang up on Black Star together. They might even be able to gain an advantage and avoid being humiliated.

As for the tag-team agreement before the battle … that was what Joey said. It had nothing to do with them.

One of them coughed and said with a deep voice, "Since you're so insistent, we can't reject your repeated invitations. Let's see what you're capable of!"

Han Xiao glanced at him and secretly gave him a thumbs up.

What a shameless sentence! You have my demeanor! I admire you!

As soon as he finished speaking, the other three no longer watched from the sidelines. They all joined the battle and displayed their abilities.

Seeing this, Joey thought of his request before the battle and blushed a little.

However, he knew that he would only be beaten up if he relied on himself. In the end, he did not open his mouth to reject the help of his three companions. Instead, he pretended to be a mute and silently cooperated with his companions.

The five of them immediately engaged in a fierce battle. They fought fiercely, causing the space walls to tremble. This secondary dimension could not withstand the aftermath of their battle and was soon riddled with holes.

…

The fierce battle lasted for a few hours, and the battlefield changed three times. It was now the fourth secondary dimension, and it looked like it was about to shatter.

There was a huge floating island here. At this time, the entire island was completely dyed red with blood, and there were summon corpses everywhere.

On the bumpy ground, Joey was covered in wounds. He leaned on his staff and panted heavily. His body was still trembling weakly, as if he had been squeezed dry.

Joey's eyes were filled with fear. He raised his trembling hand and signaled for Han Xiao not to go any further.

"We — we admit defeat. Don't come again!"

Not far away, Han Xiao stopped and said with regret, "You surrendered just like that? I still have a lot of equipment that I haven't tested yet … "

It wasn't easy to find a few new opponents to spar with, so he didn't want to end the battle quickly. He pulled out all the equipment he had made in the past few decades and used a bunch of fancy tricks to torture Joey and the others, almost leaving a psychological shadow in their hearts.

This time, it was mainly to test the equipment, so Han Xiao was not too serious and did not use his trump cards. However, even so, Joey and the others did not cause him any trouble. The situation was always under his control, and he completely crushed them in all aspects.

He had a clearer understanding of his current strength. In a head-on battle, without eleven or twelve high-level Beyond Grade As around 70,000 Energy Rank, they would not be able to pose any threat to him!

Han Xiao sighed.

"This is not even a warm-up for me. I gave you guys a chance, but you guys were useless."

Hearing this, Joey and the others were speechless.

If these words were said before the battle, they would not have been happy. However, now that they knew the difference in strength between the two sides and knew that Black Star alone could deal with all of them, the little bit of temper in their hearts was all gone.

Beyond Grade As were very realistic. If they could not win, they could not win. Even if they were unhappy, they had to endure it.

However, although Joey and the others were tortured by Han Xiao, they also saw the foundation that Han Xiao displayed and finally understood why Black Star dared to go against the three Universal Civilizations.

Black Star's mechanical technology was unbelievably strong, and his foundation was too terrifying. The Mech Legion was almost endless!

The title 'Mecha Empire' should belong to you!
